# GBIF DwC-DP analyser reports

`reports.txt` is the text output of `dwc-dp-analyser` 0.0.16 (gbif/dwc-dp-analyser, jar with
SHA-256 `5b3dbb518cdeec7cb7fbf48859f70084c457cc444f22687b8994160370965e19`), run with
`--report VERIFY` on 2026-11-23 by the maintainer. Its input was the six packages that
`AnalyserReports` in `tests/test_dwcdp.py` builds. The timestamped log lines and durations are
left out.

When moving to a new analyser release, run it on the same packages again and replace this file.
